scope: Lean model statements only (MC1 model, Mathlib oracle, transcribed literal accumulator and runtime helpers, plus the pinned NamedV1 normal-return linking and operand/continuation ABI model). No implementation theorem.
mathlib_oleans: downloaded Lake cache (lake exe cache get), not rebuilt: separate trust assumption

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofZ
theorems.claim: ofZ then toZ is the identity on ZMod (2^64)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofZ : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), NobleFoundation.toZ (NobleFoundation.ofZ r) = r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofZ_toZ
theorems.claim: toZ then ofZ is the identity on BitVec 64
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofZ_toZ : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.ofZ (NobleFoundation.toZ x) = x

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_injective
theorems.claim: toZ is injective
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_injective : Function.Injective NobleFoundation.toZ

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofZ_injective
theorems.claim: ofZ is injective
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofZ_injective : Function.Injective NobleFoundation.ofZ

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofInt
theorems.claim: toZ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n) = (n : ZMod (2^64))
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_ofInt : ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.toZ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n) = ↑n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofZ_intCast
theorems.claim: ofZ (n : ZMod (2^64)) = BitVec.ofInt 64 n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofZ_intCast : ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.ofZ ↑n = BitVec.ofInt 64 n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_add
theorems.claim: toZ is additive
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_add : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (a + b) = NobleFoundation.toZ a + NobleFoundation.toZ b

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_mul
theorems.claim: toZ is multiplicative
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_mul : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (a * b) = NobleFoundation.toZ a * NobleFoundation.toZ b

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_sub
theorems.claim: toZ preserves subtraction
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_sub : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (a - b) = NobleFoundation.toZ a - NobleFoundation.toZ b

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toZ_neg
theorems.claim: toZ preserves negation
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toZ_neg : ∀ (a : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.toZ (-a) = -NobleFoundation.toZ a

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_bmod
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.wrap n = Int.bmod n (2^64)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_bmod : ∀ (n : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap n = n.bmod (2 ^ 64)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_toInt_ofInt
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.wrap n = (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_toInt_ofInt : ∀ (n : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap n = (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_knum01
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.wrap z = ((z + 2^63) mod 2^64) - 2^63 (K-NUM-01 formula)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.wrap_eq_knum01 : ∀ (z : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap z = (z + 2 ^ 63) % 2 ^ 64 - 2 ^ 63

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_eq_toInt
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.signed r = (ofZ r).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_eq_toInt : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), MathlibI64.signed r = (NobleFoundation.ofZ r).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_toZ
theorems.claim: MathlibI64.signed (toZ x) = x.toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_toZ : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), MathlibI64.signed (NobleFoundation.toZ x) = x.toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_range
theorems.claim: every BitVec 64 decodes into [-2^63, 2^63)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_range : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), NobleFoundation.I64Range x.toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_range
theorems.claim: every residue decodes into [-2^63, 2^63)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_range : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), NobleFoundation.I64Range (MathlibI64.signed r)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.intCast_toInt
theorems.claim: ((x.toInt : ℤ) : ZMod (2^64)) = toZ x
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.intCast_toInt : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), ↑x.toInt = NobleFoundation.toZ x

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.intCast_signed
theorems.claim: residue -> signed integer -> residue is the identity
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.intCast_signed : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.Z64), ↑(MathlibI64.signed r) = r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_of_range
theorems.claim: integer -> BitVec -> integer is the identity on the I64 range
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_of_range : ∀ {n : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.I64Range n → (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_eq_iff
theorems.claim: (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n iff n is in the I64 range
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_ofInt_eq_iff : ∀ (n : ℤ), (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n ↔ NobleFoundation.I64Range n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.signed_intCast_eq_iff
theorems.claim: signed (n : ZMod (2^64)) = n iff n is in the I64 range
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.signed_intCast_eq_iff : ∀ (n : ℤ), MathlibI64.signed ↑n = n ↔ NobleFoundation.I64Range n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_toInt
theorems.claim: BitVec -> integer -> BitVec is the identity
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_toInt : ∀ (x : BitVec 64), BitVec.ofInt 64 x.toInt = x

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_wrap
theorems.claim: BitVec.ofInt 64 (wrap n) = BitVec.ofInt 64 n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_wrap : ∀ (n : ℤ), BitVec.ofInt 64 (MathlibI64.wrap n) = BitVec.ofInt 64 n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_sub
theorems.claim: BitVec.ofInt 64 (x - y) = ofInt x - ofInt y
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_sub : ∀ (x y : ℤ), BitVec.ofInt 64 (x - y) = BitVec.ofInt 64 x - BitVec.ofInt 64 y

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_add
theorems.claim: (a + b).toInt = wrap (a.toInt + b.toInt)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_add : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), (a + b).toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt + b.toInt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_sub
theorems.claim: (a - b).toInt = wrap (a.toInt - b.toInt)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_sub : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), (a - b).toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt - b.toInt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.toInt_mul
theorems.claim: (a * b).toInt = wrap (a.toInt * b.toInt)
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.toInt_mul : ∀ (a b : BitVec 64), (a * b).toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt * b.toInt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_add
theorems.claim: wrap (x + y) = (ofInt x + ofInt y).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.oracle_add : ∀ (x y : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap (x + y) = (BitVec.ofInt 64 x + BitVec.ofInt 64 y).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_sub
theorems.claim: wrap (x - y) = (ofInt x - ofInt y).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.oracle_sub : ∀ (x y : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap (x - y) = (BitVec.ofInt 64 x - BitVec.ofInt 64 y).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_mul
theorems.claim: wrap (x * y) = (ofInt x * ofInt y).toInt
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.oracle_mul : ∀ (x y : ℤ), MathlibI64.wrap (x * y) = (BitVec.ofInt 64 x * BitVec.ofInt 64 y).toInt

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.accumulate_eq_acceptLiteral
theorems.claim: the transcribed checked i64 digit accumulator accepts exactly the in-range literals, unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.accumulate_eq_acceptLiteral : ∀ (negative : Bool) (ds : List (Fin 10)), NobleFoundation.accumulate negative ds = NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.accepted_literal_exact
theorems.claim: an accepted literal is in range and decodes without wrapping
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.accepted_literal_exact : ∀ {negative : Bool} {ds : List (Fin 10)} {n : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds = some n → NobleFoundation.I64Range n ∧ n = NobleFoundation.literalValue negative ds ∧ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral_eq_none_iff
theorems.claim: a literal is rejected iff its value is outside the I64 range
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral_eq_none_iff : ∀ (negative : Bool) (ds : List (Fin 10)), NobleFoundation.acceptLiteral negative ds = none ↔ ¬NobleFoundation.I64Range (NobleFoundation.literalValue negative ds)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ofInt_collapses_out_of_range
theorems.claim: BitVec.ofInt identifies 2^63 with -2^63; only the latter is an accepted literal
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ofInt_collapses_out_of_range : BitVec.ofInt 64 (2 ^ 63) = BitVec.ofInt 64 (-2 ^ 63) ∧ 2 ^ 63 ≠ -2 ^ 63 ∧ ¬NobleFoundation.I64Range (2 ^ 63) ∧ NobleFoundation.I64Range (-2 ^ 63)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.literal_range_iff_no_wrap
theorems.claim: I64Range n iff BitVec.ofInt 64 n decodes to n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.literal_range_iff_no_wrap : ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.I64Range n ↔ (BitVec.ofInt 64 n).toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.literal_boundary_regressions
theorems.claim: accumulator: 2^63 rejected; -2^63, 2^63-1, -(2^63-1), -0 accepted; -(2^63+1) rejected
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.literal_boundary_regressions : NobleFoundation.accumulate false NobleFoundation.digitsTwoPow63 = none ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true NobleFoundation.digitsTwoPow63 = some (-9223372036854775808) ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate false NobleFoundation.digitsMax = some 9223372036854775807 ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true NobleFoundation.digitsMax = some (-9223372036854775807) ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true [0] = some 0 ∧ NobleFoundation.accumulate true [9, 2, 2, 3, 3, 7, 2, 0, 3, 6, 8, 5, 4, 7, 7, 5, 8, 0, 9] = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_iff
theorems.claim: Represents v n iff v = .i64 x with x.toInt = n
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.represents_iff : ∀ (v : NobleContracts.Value) (n : ℤ), NobleFoundation.Represents v n ↔ ∃ x, v = NobleContracts.Value.i64 x ∧ x.toInt = n

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_functional
theorems.claim: an I64 value represents at most one integer
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.represents_functional : ∀ {v : NobleContracts.Value} {n m : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.Represents v n → NobleFoundation.Represents v m → n = m

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_of_hasType
theorems.claim: every well-typed I64 value represents its toInt
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.represents_of_hasType : ∀ {v : NobleContracts.Value} (h : NobleContracts.HasType v NobleContracts.Ty.i64), NobleFoundation.Represents v (match v, h with | NobleContracts.Value.i64 x, h => x.toInt | x, h => 0)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.hasType_of_represents
theorems.claim: represented values are typed I64
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.hasType_of_represents : ∀ {v : NobleContracts.Value} {n : ℤ}, NobleFoundation.Represents v n → NobleContracts.HasType v NobleContracts.Ty.i64

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.represents_wrap
theorems.claim: i64v (wrap z) represents wrap z
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.represents_wrap : ∀ (z : ℤ), NobleFoundation.Represents (NobleFoundation.i64v (MathlibI64.wrap z)) (MathlibI64.wrap z)

theorems.name: NobleContracts.StackTyped.append
theorems.claim: StackTyped is closed under public-orientation concatenation
theorems.statement: @NobleContracts.StackTyped.append : ∀ {s t : NobleContracts.Stack} {ts tt : List NobleContracts.Ty}, NobleContracts.StackTyped s ts → NobleContracts.StackTyped t tt → NobleContracts.StackTyped (s ++ t) (ts ++ tt)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.stackTyped_snoc_i64
theorems.claim: pushing an I64 extends the typed public stack
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.stackTyped_snoc_i64 : ∀ {s : NobleContracts.Stack} {ts : List NobleContracts.Ty}, NobleContracts.StackTyped s ts → ∀ (n : ℤ), NobleContracts.StackTyped (s ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v n]) (ts ++ [NobleContracts.Ty.i64])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.internal_of_public
theorems.claim: public pre ++ [a, b] is internal b :: a :: reverse pre
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.internal_of_public : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (a b : NobleContracts.Value), List.reverse (pre ++ [a, b]) = b :: a :: List.reverse pre

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_sub_is_internal_step
theorems.claim: public subtraction is internal Step.sub with the public top as subtrahend
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_sub_is_internal_step : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (a b : BitVec 64) (t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 5] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ NobleContracts.Step (NobleContracts.Op.word 5) (NobleContracts.Value.i64 b :: NobleContracts.Value.i64 a :: List.reverse pre) (List.reverse t)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_spec
theorems.claim: ArithSpec 4 (+): typed, prefix preserved, unique normal result i64v (wrap (x + y))
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.add_spec : NobleFoundation.ArithSpec 4 fun x1 x2 => x1 + x2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.sub_spec
theorems.claim: ArithSpec 5 (-): typed, prefix preserved, unique normal result i64v (wrap (x - y)), x deeper
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.sub_spec : NobleFoundation.ArithSpec 5 fun x1 x2 => x1 - x2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.mul_spec
theorems.claim: ArithSpec 6 (*): typed, prefix preserved, unique normal result i64v (wrap (x * y))
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.mul_spec : NobleFoundation.ArithSpec 6 fun x1 x2 => x1 * x2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_arith_toInt
theorems.claim: for arbitrary BitVec operands the add/sub/mul result decodes to wrap of decoded operands
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_arith_toInt : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (a b : BitVec 64) (t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 4] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ ∃ r, t = pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 r] ∧ r.toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt + b.toInt)) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 5] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ ∃ r, t = pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 r] ∧ r.toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt - b.toInt)) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 6] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 a, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ↔ ∃ r, t = pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 r] ∧ r.toInt = MathlibI64.wrap (a.toInt * b.toInt))

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_needs_i64
theorems.claim: add has no normal transition when either operand is not I64
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.add_needs_i64 : ∀ (pre : NobleContracts.Stack) (b : BitVec 64) (t : NobleContracts.Stack), ¬NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 4] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.bool true, NobleContracts.Value.i64 b]) t ∧ ¬NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.word 4] (pre ++ [NobleContracts.Value.i64 b, NobleContracts.Value.bool true]) t

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.refRun_append
theorems.claim: reference machine sequencing
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.refRun_append : ∀ (a b : List NobleFoundation.AOp) (zs : List ℤ), NobleFoundation.refRun (a ++ b) zs = (NobleFoundation.refRun a zs).bind (NobleFoundation.refRun b)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.depthRun_append
theorems.claim: static depth sequencing
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.depthRun_append : ∀ (a b : List NobleFoundation.AOp) (k : ℕ), NobleFoundation.depthRun (a ++ b) k = (NobleFoundation.depthRun a k).bind (NobleFoundation.depthRun b)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.run_lowerAll
theorems.claim: internal-orientation simulation of lowered sequences by the reference machine
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.run_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → ∀ (r t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Run (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (List.map NobleFoundation.i64v zs ++ r) t ↔ t = List.map NobleFoundation.i64v zs' ++ r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll
theorems.claim: public lifting: any prefix, unique normal result pre ++ enc (reference result)
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.exec_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.refRun_range
theorems.claim: reference stacks stay in the I64 range
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.refRun_range : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → (∀ z ∈ zs, NobleFoundation.I64Range z) → ∀ z ∈ zs', NobleFoundation.I64Range z

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.depthRun_of_refRun
theorems.claim: reference success implies the static depth check
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.depthRun_of_refRun : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun ops zs = some zs' → NobleFoundation.depthRun ops zs.length = some zs'.length

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.codeTyped_lowerAll
theorems.claim: depth check implies CodeTyped from base ++ k*I64 to base ++ k'*I64
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.codeTyped_lowerAll : ∀ {ops : List NobleFoundation.AOp} {k k' : ℕ}, NobleFoundation.depthRun ops k = some k' → ∀ (base : List NobleContracts.Ty), NobleContracts.CodeTyped (NobleFoundation.lowerAll ops) (base ++ List.replicate k NobleContracts.Ty.i64) (base ++ List.replicate k' NobleContracts.Ty.i64)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.body_eq
theorems.claim: composed body is the lowering of the flattened sequence
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.body_eq : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr), P.body = NobleFoundation.lowerAll P.flat

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code
theorems.claim: construction pushes exactly one program value and executes nothing
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec P.code s t ↔ t = s ++ [NobleContracts.Value.program P.body]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_run
theorems.claim: construct then run = execute the composed body
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_run : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) s t ↔ NobleContracts.Exec P.body s t

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_reflect
theorems.claim: reflect observes exactly the composed recipe
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_code_reflect : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 11]) s t ↔ t = s ++ [NobleContracts.Value.syntax P.body]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_run_ref
theorems.claim: quote/block/compose/run equals the reference machine with any preserved prefix
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.exec_run_ref : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) {zs zs' : List ℤ}, NobleFoundation.refRun P.flat zs = some zs' → ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs) t ↔ t = pre ++ NobleFoundation.enc zs'

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped
theorems.claim: construction code is CodeTyped on any stack type
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (S base : List NobleContracts.Ty) {k k' : ℕ}, NobleFoundation.depthRun P.flat k = some k' → NobleContracts.CodeTyped P.code S (S ++ [NobleContracts.Ty.program (base ++ List.replicate k NobleContracts.Ty.i64) (base ++ List.replicate k' NobleContracts.Ty.i64)])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped_run
theorems.claim: construct-then-run is CodeTyped with the whole-stack input premise
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PExpr.codeTyped_run : ∀ (P : NobleFoundation.PExpr) (base : List NobleContracts.Ty) {k k' : ℕ}, NobleFoundation.depthRun P.flat k = some k' → NobleContracts.CodeTyped (P.code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (base ++ List.replicate k NobleContracts.Ty.i64) (base ++ List.replicate k' NobleContracts.Ty.i64)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.exec_quote_program_run_run
theorems.claim: nested quotation: quote a program, run twice = run it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.exec_quote_program_run_run : ∀ (p : List NobleContracts.Op) (s t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec [NobleContracts.Op.block p, NobleContracts.Op.word 8, NobleContracts.Op.word 10, NobleContracts.Op.word 10] s t ↔ NobleContracts.Exec p s t

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.oracle_boundaries
theorems.claim: signed min/max, zero and negative oracle boundaries

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.sub_operand_order
theorems.claim: 3 8 - is -5, 8 3 - is 5, and they differ
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.sub_operand_order : ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 3, NobleFoundation.AOp.push 8, NobleFoundation.AOp.sub]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v (-5)]) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 8, NobleFoundation.AOp.push 3, NobleFoundation.AOp.sub]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 5]) ∧ NobleFoundation.i64v (-5) ≠ NobleFoundation.i64v 5

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.add_max_wraps_preserving_prefix
theorems.claim: max + 1 wraps to min above a non-I64 prefix
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.add_max_wraps_preserving_prefix : ∀ (t : NobleContracts.Stack), NobleContracts.Exec (NobleFoundation.lowerAll [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 9223372036854775807, NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add]) [NobleContracts.Value.bool true, NobleContracts.Value.text "kept"] t ↔ t = [NobleContracts.Value.bool true, NobleContracts.Value.text "kept", NobleFoundation.i64v (-9223372036854775808)]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.out_of_range_push_refused
theorems.claim: reference refuses push 2^63 although MC1 lowering would alias it to -2^63
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.out_of_range_push_refused : NobleFoundation.refRun [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 9223372036854775808] [] = none ∧ (NobleFoundation.AOp.push 9223372036854775808).lower = (NobleFoundation.AOp.push (-9223372036854775808)).lower

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.quote_compose_run_examples
theorems.claim: 5 quote [1 +] compose run = 6; max quote [1 +] compose run = min
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.quote_compose_run_examples : ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec (((NobleFoundation.PExpr.quoted 5).compose (NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add])).code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 6]) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec (((NobleFoundation.PExpr.quoted 9223372036854775807).compose (NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add])).code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) pre t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v (-9223372036854775808)])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.compose_order_matters
theorems.claim: [2 *][1 +] compose and reverse differ on 5
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.compose_order_matters : ∀ (pre t : NobleContracts.Stack), (NobleContracts.Exec (((NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 2, NobleFoundation.AOp.mul]).compose (NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add])).code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 5]) t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 11]) ∧ (NobleContracts.Exec (((NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 1, NobleFoundation.AOp.add]).compose (NobleFoundation.PExpr.arith [NobleFoundation.AOp.push 2, NobleFoundation.AOp.mul])).code ++ [NobleContracts.Op.word 10]) (pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 5]) t ↔ t = pre ++ [NobleFoundation.i64v 12]) ∧ NobleFoundation.i64v 11 ≠ NobleFoundation.i64v 12

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.wrap_sub_noncommutative

theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.Effects.step_trace : ∀ {H : ℕ → NobleFoundation.Effects.Response} {E : List NobleFoundation.Effects.Label} {c c' : NobleFoundation.Effects.Cfg}, NobleFoundation.Effects.WT E c → NobleFoundation.Effects.Step H c c' → c'.trace = c.trace ∨ ∃ ev, c'.trace = c.trace ++ [ev] ∧ ev.label ∈ E

theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.Effects.effect_sound : ∀ {H : ℕ → NobleFoundation.Effects.Response} {E : List NobleFoundation.Effects.Label} {c c' : NobleFoundation.Effects.Cfg}, NobleFoundation.Effects.WT E c → NobleFoundation.Effects.Reach H c c' → ∃ new, c'.trace = c.trace ++ new ∧ ∀ ev ∈ new, ev.label ∈ E

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Effects.trace_within_bound

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Effects.bound_does_not_fix_order
theorems.claim: same bound, different ordered traces: the bound does not justify reordering
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Effects.bound_does_not_fix_order : have p₁ := [NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 1), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit, NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 2), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit]; have p₂ := [NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 2), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit, NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 1), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit]; NobleFoundation.Effects.CodeT [NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit] p₁ [] [] ∧ NobleFoundation.Effects.CodeT [NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit] p₂ [] [] ∧ NobleFoundation.Effects.Reach (fun x => NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted) (NobleFoundation.Effects.init p₁) { code := [], stack := [], live := [], next := 0, trace := [{ label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 1, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }, { label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 2, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }], status := NobleFoundation.Effects.Status.running } ∧ NobleFoundation.Effects.Reach (fun x => NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted) (NobleFoundation.Effects.init p₂) { code := [], stack := [], live := [], next := 0, trace := [{ label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 2, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }, { label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 1, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }], status := NobleFoundation.Effects.Status.running } ∧ [{ label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 1, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }, { label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 2, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }] ≠ [{ label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 2, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }, { label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 1, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.permitted }]

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Effects.denied_request_recorded_and_halts : NobleFoundation.Effects.Reach (fun x => NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.denied) (NobleFoundation.Effects.init [NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 7), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit, NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 8), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit]) { code := [NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit, NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 8), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit], stack := [NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 7], live := [], next := 0, trace := [{ label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 7, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.denied }], status := NobleFoundation.Effects.Status.denied } ∧ ∀ (c' : NobleFoundation.Effects.Cfg), ¬NobleFoundation.Effects.Step (fun x => NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.denied) { code := [NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit, NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.push (NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 8), NobleFoundation.Effects.EOp.emit], stack := [NobleFoundation.Effects.EVal.i64 7], live := [], next := 0, trace := [{ label := NobleFoundation.Effects.Label.emit, arg := 7, response := NobleFoundation.Effects.Response.denied }], status := NobleFoundation.Effects.Status.denied } c'
