theorems.claim: the ordered affine fold rounds away the bias before the cancellation where re-association would keep it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Binary32.fold_order_is_load_bearing : NobleFoundation.Binary32.fold NobleFoundation.Binary32.oneBits [(NobleFoundation.Binary32.oneBits, NobleFoundation.Binary32.twoPow24Bits), (NobleFoundation.Binary32.negOneBits, NobleFoundation.Binary32.twoPow24Bits)] = NobleFoundation.Binary32.zeroOf false ∧ NobleFoundation.Binary32.add NobleFoundation.Binary32.oneBits (NobleFoundation.Binary32.add (NobleFoundation.Binary32.mul NobleFoundation.Binary32.oneBits NobleFoundation.Binary32.twoPow24Bits) (NobleFoundation.Binary32.mul NobleFoundation.Binary32.negOneBits NobleFoundation.Binary32.twoPow24Bits)) = NobleFoundation.Binary32.oneBits

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte_excludes_structure
theorems.claim: an acquired name byte is neither the closing quote nor an angle bracket
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte_excludes_structure : ∀ (byte : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true → byte ≠ 34 ∧ byte ≠ 60 ∧ byte ≠ 62

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix_length
theorems.claim: the record prefix is ten bytes
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix_length : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix.length = 10

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix_length
theorems.claim: the record suffix is five bytes whatever the readiness tag is
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix_length : ∀ (ready : Bool), (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready).length = 5

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode_length
theorems.claim: a canonical encoding is fifteen bytes longer than its name
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode_length : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready).length = 15 + name.length

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthExceeds_encode
theorems.claim: the canonical encoding opens exactly one bracket, so an acquired configured depth accepts it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthExceeds_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool) (configuredDepth : ℕ), 1 ≤ configuredDepth → (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthExceeds configuredDepth (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.takeName_encode
theorems.claim: the name scanner consumes exactly the name and the closing quote of a canonical encoding
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.takeName_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (tag : ℕ), (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.takeName (name ++ [34, 32, 35, tag, 62]) = some (name, [32, 35, tag, 62])

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.parseService_encode
theorems.claim: the closed-schema parser recognizes the canonical encoding of an acquired value
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.parseService_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.parseService (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready) = some (name, ready)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode_encode
theorems.claim: a value round-trips: for an acquired name and configured depth, decoding the canonical encoding yields that value
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode_encode : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool) (configuredDepth : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName name = true → 1 ≤ configuredDepth ∧ configuredDepth ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireDepth → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready) configuredDepth = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted name ready

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode_of_accepted
theorems.claim: an accepted byte sequence is exactly the canonical encoding of the value it decodes to
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode_of_accepted : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (configuredDepth : ℕ) (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes configuredDepth = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted name ready → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready = bytes

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_fits_wire_budget
theorems.claim: the longest acquired name still fits the 64-byte wire budget
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_fits_wire_budget : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName name = true → (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode name ready).length ≤ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.maxWireBytes

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.byte_limit_precedes_depth_scan
theorems.claim: the byte budget is decided before the depth scan
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.byte_limit_precedes_depth_scan : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (List.replicate 65 60) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.byteLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_configuration_precedes_schema
theorems.claim: an unacquired configured depth rejects a well-formed record as a depth failure
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_configuration_precedes_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true) 0 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit ∧ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true) 5 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_scan_precedes_schema
theorems.claim: the bracket count is decided before the schema match
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depth_scan_precedes_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 60, 60, 60, 60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 34, 120, 34, 32, 35, 116, 62, 62, 62, 62, 62] 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.depthLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.altered_readiness_is_schema
theorems.claim: a readiness tag other than #t or #f is a schema failure
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.altered_readiness_is_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] ++ [34, 32, 35, 120, 62]) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.trailing_bytes_are_schema
theorems.claim: trailing bytes are rejected, so the decoder is a document decoder and not a prefix decoder
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.trailing_bytes_are_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true ++ [98]) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.empty_name_is_schema
theorems.claim: an empty name is rejected although the rest of the record is well formed
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.empty_name_is_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ [] ++ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix true) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.foreign_name_byte_is_schema
theorems.claim: a name byte outside the acquired alphabet is rejected, which is the model form of the non-ASCII and wrong-alphabet rejections
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.foreign_name_byte_is_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ [99, 255] ++ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix true) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.schema_controls_have_accepted_neighbours
theorems.claim: each schema control has an accepted neighbour differing only in the named part, so it is refused for the case it names
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.schema_controls_have_accepted_neighbours : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] ++ [34, 32, 35, 116, 62]) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted [99, 108, 111, 99, 107] true ∧ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ [99] ++ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix true) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted [99] true ∧ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ [99, 100] ++ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix true) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted [99, 100] true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.overlong_name_decodes_to_schema
theorems.claim: a record with a 33-byte name fits the wire budget and is refused by the decoder's name bound
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.overlong_name_decodes_to_schema : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode (List.replicate 33 97) false) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.the_full_wire_budget_is_not_a_byte_limit
theorems.claim: 64 bytes pass the byte limit and 65 bytes do not
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.the_full_wire_budget_is_not_a_byte_limit : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (List.replicate 64 120) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema ∧ NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (List.replicate 65 120) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.byteLimit

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.accepted_name_is_valid
theorems.claim: every name the decoder accepts satisfies the name predicate
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.accepted_name_is_valid : ∀ (bytes : List ℕ) (depth : ℕ) (name : List ℕ) (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode bytes depth = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted name ready → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName name = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.overlong_name_is_rejected
theorems.claim: a 33-byte name exceeds the name budget
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.overlong_name_is_rejected : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.validName (List.replicate 33 97) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_round_trips
theorems.claim: the longest acquired name round-trips, which is the name bound exact accepting edge
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.longest_name_round_trips : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode (List.replicate 32 97) false) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted (List.replicate 32 97) false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.shortest_name_round_trips
theorems.claim: the shortest acquired name round-trips
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.shortest_name_round_trips : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.encode [97] true) 4 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.accepted [97] true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordPrefix
theorems.claim: the record prefix opens one bracket and closes none, so the balanced scan reaches depth one
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordPrefix : ∀ (rest : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux 0 0 (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordPrefix ++ rest) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux 1 1 rest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_of_plain
theorems.claim: a name byte is neither an opener nor a closer, so a name drawn from the admitted alphabet leaves the scan unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_of_plain : ∀ (name : List ℕ) (current reached : ℕ) (rest : List ℕ), (∀ byte ∈ name, NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.nameByte byte = true) → NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux current reached (name ++ rest) = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux current reached rest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordSuffix
theorems.claim: the record suffix closes the prefix's bracket and opens none, so the scan reaches at most depth one
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux_recordSuffix : ∀ (ready : Bool), NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.depthScanAux 1 1 (NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.recordSuffix ready) = 1

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.unbalanced_closers_do_not_count_toward_the_depth
theorems.claim: an input with stray openers and a closing byte below zero depth is a schema failure at depth two, not a depth failure
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.unbalanced_closers_do_not_count_toward_the_depth : NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.decode [60, 115, 101, 114, 118, 105, 99, 101, 32, 34, 60, 97, 34, 32, 35, 116, 62, 60] 2 = NobleFoundation.ServiceWire.Decision.schema

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable_iff
theorems.claim: a payload is duplicable exactly when no resource occurs at any depth
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable_iff : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true ↔ NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource payload = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.data_duplicable
theorems.claim: every data payload is duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.data_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.data tag) = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_not_duplicable
theorems.claim: a must-use resource payload is never duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_not_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_duplicable
theorems.claim: wrapping a payload never changes its eligibility, so eligibility is recursive
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_duplicable : ∀ (inner : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable inner.wrapped = NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable inner

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_data_duplicable
theorems.claim: a wrapped data payload is duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_data_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.data tag).wrapped = true

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_resource_not_duplicable
theorems.claim: a wrapped resource payload is not duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapped_resource_not_duplicable : ∀ (tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag).wrapped = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_preserves_eligibility
theorems.claim: eligibility is unchanged at every wrapping depth
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_preserves_eligibility : ∀ (depth : ℕ) (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth depth payload) = NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_resource_not_duplicable
theorems.claim: no wrapping depth makes a resource payload duplicable
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth_resource_not_duplicable : ∀ (depth tag : ℕ), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable (NobleFoundation.Ownership.wrapDepth depth (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag)) = false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_operand_blocks_non_swap_word
theorems.claim: a must-use resource as the constrained operand blocks every non-swap word of the fragment
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.resource_operand_blocks_non_swap_word : ∀ (word : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word) (tag : ℕ) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), word ≠ NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.swap → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step word (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource tag :: rest) = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.drop_consumes_one
theorems.claim: dropping consumes exactly the duplicable operand it inspected and no must-use obligation
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.drop_consumes_one : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.drop (payload :: rest) = some rest

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.dup_duplicates_one
theorems.claim: duplication preserves both copies of the duplicable operand
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.dup_duplicates_one : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.dup (payload :: rest) = some (payload :: payload :: rest)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.quote_retains_one
theorems.claim: quoting retains the obligation it inspected rather than consuming it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.quote_retains_one : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.duplicable payload = true → NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.quote (payload :: rest) = some (payload :: rest)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.swap_permutes_two
theorems.claim: swapping permutes two operands, including resources, and consumes neither
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.swap_permutes_two : ∀ (left right : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.step NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.swap (left :: right :: rest) = some (right :: left :: rest)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.swap_moves_a_resource
theorems.claim: the decided swap fixture moves a resource past a data operand without an eligibility check
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.swap_moves_a_resource : NobleFoundation.Ownership.run (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program.word NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.swap) [NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource 1, NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.data 2] = some [NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.data 2, NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload.resource 1]

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.run_sound
theorems.claim: checker acceptance implies the declarative accounting judgment
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.run_sound : ∀ (program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.run program operands = some out → NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts program operands out

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.branch_accounts_both_arms
theorems.claim: a two-arm branch accounts for the same obligations on both arms
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.branch_accounts_both_arms : ∀ (thenArm elseArm : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (start out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts (thenArm.branch elseArm) start out → NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts thenArm start out ∧ NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts elseArm start out

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_requires_empty_operands
theorems.claim: a normal error return is acquired only with no outstanding operand
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_requires_empty_operands : ∀ (start out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program.fail start out → start = [] ∧ out = []

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_rejects_outstanding_operand
theorems.claim: an outstanding operand is never abandoned by the error-return alternative
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.fail_rejects_outstanding_operand : ∀ (payload : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (rest : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.run NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program.fail (payload :: rest) = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.Ownership.segment_conserved
theorems.claim: accepting a runConfiguration result with the original segment implies the operand result is accepted by run; segment equality is proved separately
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.Ownership.segment_conserved : ∀ (segment : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.runConfiguration segment program operands = some (segment, out) → NobleFoundation.Ownership.run program operands = some out

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.step_conserves_obligations
theorems.claim: an accepted word preserves the ordered multiset of must-use resources
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.step_conserves_obligations : ∀ (word : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word) (operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.step word operands = some out → (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource out).Perm (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource operands)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.accounts_conserves_obligations
theorems.claim: every declaratively accounted program preserves the ordered multiset of must-use resources
theorems.statement: @NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.accounts_conserves_obligations : ∀ {program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program} {operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload}, NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts program operands out → (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource out).Perm (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource operands)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.run_conserves_obligations
theorems.claim: checker acceptance preserves the ordered multiset of must-use resources
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.run_conserves_obligations : ∀ (program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (operands out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.run program operands = some out → (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource out).Perm (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource operands)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.runConfiguration_segment_preserved
theorems.claim: a successful runConfiguration result has exactly the segment supplied to it
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.runConfiguration_segment_preserved : ∀ (segment : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload) (program : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program) (operands segment' out : List NobleFoundation.Ownership.Payload), NobleFoundation.Ownership.runConfiguration segment program operands = some (segment', out) → segment' = segment

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resource_carry_run
theorems.claim: the concrete dup-then-drop data-word fixture is accepted while carrying a resource tail unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resource_carry_run : NobleFoundation.Ownership.run NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resourceCarryProgram NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resourceCarryInput = some NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resourceCarryOutput

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resource_carry_accounts
theorems.claim: the concrete resource-carry fixture has a declarative Accounts derivation
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resource_carry_accounts : NobleFoundation.Ownership.Accounts NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resourceCarryProgram NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resourceCarryInput NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.resourceCarryOutput

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.swap_moves_resource_conservation
theorems.claim: the decided swap fixture moves a resource while preserving the filtered obligation permutation
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.swap_moves_resource_conservation : NobleFoundation.Ownership.run (NobleFoundation.Ownership.Program.word NobleFoundation.Ownership.Word.swap) NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.swapResourceInput = some NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.swapResourceOutput ∧ (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.swapResourceOutput).Perm (List.filter NobleFoundation.Ownership.containsResource NobleFoundation.OwnershipConservation.swapResourceInput)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_preserves_other_keys
theorems.claim: one single-slot publication leaves every other slot selection unchanged
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_preserves_other_keys : ∀ (entries : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap) (key other generation : ℕ), key ≠ other → NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish entries key generation) other = NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select entries other

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_selects_the_published_generation
theorems.claim: one single-slot publication selects exactly the published generation for its own slot
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish_selects_the_published_generation : ∀ (entries : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap) (key generation : ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.publish entries key generation) key = some generation

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pin_is_immutable
theorems.claim: pinning stores the published map and nothing replaces it in place
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pin_is_immutable : ∀ (epoch : ℕ) (entries : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap), (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinRoot epoch entries).pinned = entries

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.root_selections_use_pinned_map
theorems.claim: every live selection a root makes comes from its own pinned map
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.root_selections_use_pinned_map : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (requests : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.trace root requests = List.filterMap (fun key => match NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select root.pinned key with | some generation => some (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.GuestEvent.dispatch root.epoch key generation) | none => none) requests

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.frozen_entry_map_reference_agrees
theorems.claim: execution through a root equals the frozen-entry-map reference for the same requests
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.frozen_entry_map_reference_agrees : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (requests : List ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.trace root requests = NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.reference root.epoch root.pinned requests

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.mixed_map_selects_old_and_new
theorems.claim: two separate single-slot publications are not one atomic replacement, so a map pinned between them selects a mixed pair
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.mixed_map_selects_old_and_new : ∀ (fresh : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.mixedMap fresh) 0 = some 2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.denied_dispatch_produces_no_guest_event
theorems.claim: a denied dispatch stops execution before producing a guest event
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.denied_dispatch_produces_no_guest_event : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (key : ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorize false root key = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorized_dispatch_selects_the_pinned_generation
theorems.claim: an authorized dispatch selects the generation its pinned map names
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorized_dispatch_selects_the_pinned_generation : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (key generation : ℕ), NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select root.pinned key = some generation → NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.authorize true root key = some (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.GuestEvent.dispatch root.epoch key generation)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.abnormal_prefix_preserves_committed_events
theorems.claim: a finite abnormal prefix keeps the committed guest events
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.abnormal_prefix_preserves_committed_events : ∀ (root : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Root) (before : List ℕ) (deniedKey : ℕ), (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.abnormalPrefix root before deniedKey).1 = NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.trace root before

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.run_extends_the_events
theorems.claim: a dispatch run only appends guest events: the events it starts with stay a prefix
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.run_extends_the_events : ∀ (programs : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Programs) (epoch : ℕ) (view : ℕ → NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap) (allowed : ℕ → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) (stack : List NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Frame) (state : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.RunState), state.events <+: (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.run programs epoch view allowed fuel stack state).events

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.denials_only_truncate
theorems.claim: for every policy, the events a run commits are a prefix of the fully authorised run's events from the same state: a denial stops execution and never rolls back or invents an event
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.denials_only_truncate : ∀ (programs : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Programs) (epoch : ℕ) (view : ℕ → NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.EntryMap) (allowed : ℕ → Bool) (fuel : ℕ) (stack : List NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.Frame) (state : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.RunState), state.stopped = false → (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.run programs epoch view allowed fuel stack state).events <+: (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.run programs epoch view (fun x => true) fuel stack state).events

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.coherent_pins_emit_exactly_once
theorems.claim: coherent all-old and all-new pins emit the relocated event exactly once, for the relocation and its reverse
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.coherent_pins_emit_exactly_once : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allOld } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 1 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 2, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allNew } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 1 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.reverseRelocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allOld } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 1 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.reverseRelocation { epoch := 2, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allNew } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 1

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.current_map_selection_duplicates_and_omits
theorems.claim: with the callee published between hops, current-map selection duplicates the event under the relocation and omits it under the reverse, while a root pinned before the publication emits it once
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.current_map_selection_duplicates_and_omits : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.currentMapRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation 1 NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.calleePublishedBetweenHops NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 2 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.currentMapRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.reverseRelocation 1 NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.calleePublishedBetweenHops NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 0 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allOld } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 1 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.reverseRelocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allOld } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 1

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.a_root_pinned_between_sequential_publications_can_mix
theorems.claim: a root pinned between two single-slot publications selects a mixed pair from its one map, which omits or duplicates the event
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.a_root_pinned_between_sequential_publications_can_mix : NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.newCallerOldCallee 0 = some 2 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.newCallerOldCallee 1 = some 1 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.newCallerOldCallee } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 0 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.oldCallerNewCallee 0 = some 1 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.select NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.oldCallerNewCallee 1 = some 2 ∧ NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.emissions (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.oldCallerNewCallee } NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.everyDispatch 16 0).events = 2

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.a_denial_before_the_emitting_hop_keeps_the_prefix
theorems.claim: a denial before the emitting hop emits nothing and keeps the committed dispatch prefix
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.a_denial_before_the_emitting_hop_keeps_the_prefix : (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 2, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allNew } (fun index => decide (index = 0)) 16 0).events = [NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.GuestEvent.dispatch 2 0 2] ∧ (NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.pinnedRequest NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.relocation { epoch := 1, pinned := NobleFoundation.LiveDispatch.allOld } (fun x => false) 16 0).events = []

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_same
theorems.claim: Charging a matching checkpoint entry adds its cost to that checkpoint total.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_same : ∀ (checkpoint : ℕ) (charges : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (cost : ℕ), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ((checkpoint, cost) :: charges) = cost + NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint charges

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_other
theorems.claim: Charging a different checkpoint leaves this checkpoint total unchanged.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor_cons_other : ∀ (checkpoint other : ℕ) (charges : List (ℕ × ℕ)) (cost : ℕ), other ≠ checkpoint → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ((other, cost) :: charges) = NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint charges

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_alignment
theorems.claim: The initial ledger has aligned consumed witnesses and registered attempts.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_alignment : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_uniqueness
theorems.claim: The initial ledger consumes no witness twice.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_uniqueness : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_within_quota
theorems.claim: The initial ledger charges nothing, so it is within any snapshot.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_within_quota : ∀ (snapshot : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Snapshot), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial snapshot

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_started_at_most_once
theorems.claim: The initial ledger registers no attempt, so at-most-once starts holds.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_started_at_most_once : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.StartedAtMostOnce NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.refused_request_preserves_ledger
theorems.claim: A refusal leaves the ledger definitionally unchanged; only separate counters move.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.refused_request_preserves_ledger : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.refuse ledger facts = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.denied_admission_preserves_ledger
theorems.claim: Accepting an already consumed witness refuses and preserves the ledger.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.denied_admission_preserves_ledger : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∈ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_consumes_exactly_one_witness
theorems.claim: A fresh witness under admissible facts adds exactly that witness to the consumed set.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_consumes_exactly_one_witness : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint).consumed = witness :: ledger.consumed

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_registers_one_attempt
theorems.claim: The same step registers exactly one not-yet-started attempt.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_registers_one_attempt : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint).attempts = { witness := witness, checkpoint := checkpoint, cost := facts.cost, started := false } :: ledger.attempts

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.altered_plan_cannot_mint
theorems.claim: An altered requested plan fails exact equality and mints nothing.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.altered_plan_cannot_mint : ∀ (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ) (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → facts.plan ≠ facts.requestedPlan → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.stale_facts_cannot_mint
theorems.claim: Revoked, invalid-checkpoint, stale-policy or unauthenticated facts mint nothing.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.stale_facts_cannot_mint : ∀ (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ) (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → facts.revoked = true ∨ facts.checkpointValid = false ∨ facts.policyLive = false ∨ facts.sourceAuthentic = false → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = ledger

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_is_consumption
theorems.claim: A fresh admissible request reaches the consuming transition.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_is_consumption : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint = NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.consume ledger facts witness checkpoint

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_alignment
theorems.claim: One admission keeps consumed witnesses aligned with registered attempts.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_alignment : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_uniqueness
theorems.claim: One admission keeps no witness consumed twice.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_uniqueness : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_quota
theorems.claim: One admission keeps checkpoint charges within the supplied snapshot when the acquired cost fits.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_quota : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (snapshot : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Snapshot) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota ledger snapshot → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ledger.charges + facts.cost ≤ snapshot checkpoint → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint) snapshot

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.started_attempt_cannot_start_again
theorems.claim: Starting an already started attempt is refused rather than counted twice.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.started_attempt_cannot_start_again : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (attempt : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Attempt), List.find? (fun other => decide (other.witness = attempt.witness)) ledger.attempts = some attempt → attempt.started = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.start ledger attempt.witness = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_attempts_charged
theorems.claim: Ledger invariant of the checkpoint-scoped authority model.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial_attempts_charged : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_attempts_charged
theorems.claim: One admission keeps every registered attempt cost present in the checkpoint charges.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.admission_preserves_attempts_charged : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.FactsAdmissible facts = true → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.accept ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.omitted_quota_charge_breaks_accounting
theorems.claim: A consuming transition that forgets the quota charge breaks the attempt/charge accounting invariant.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.omitted_quota_charge_breaks_accounting : ∀ (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), ¬NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.AttemptsCharged (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.consumeUncharged NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.initial facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.unchecked_reuse_breaks_uniqueness
theorems.claim: A transition that skips freshness consumes a witness twice and breaks uniqueness.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.unchecked_reuse_breaks_uniqueness : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∈ ledger.consumed → ¬NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessUniqueness (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.consumeUnchecked ledger facts witness checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.plan_blind_admission_mints_altered_plan
theorems.claim: An admission ignoring exact plan equality mints an altered-plan attempt.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.plan_blind_admission_mints_altered_plan : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → facts.plan ≠ facts.requestedPlan → (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.acceptIgnoringPlan ledger facts witness checkpoint).consumed = witness :: ledger.consumed

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.checkpoint_blind_admission_mints_stale_checkpoint
theorems.claim: An admission ignoring checkpoint validity registers an attempt on stale facts.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.checkpoint_blind_admission_mints_stale_checkpoint : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (facts : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (witness checkpoint : ℕ), witness ∉ ledger.consumed → facts.checkpointValid = false → (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.acceptIgnoringCheckpoint ledger facts witness checkpoint).attempts.length = ledger.attempts.length + 1

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.prefix_preserves_alignment
theorems.claim: Ledger invariant of the checkpoint-scoped authority model.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.prefix_preserves_alignment : ∀ (requests : List NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Facts) (checkpoint : ℕ) (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment ledger → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WitnessAlignment (NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.acceptPrefix ledger requests checkpoint)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.renewed_snapshot_keeps_quota
theorems.claim: A renewal snapshot that carries prior charges forward keeps the quota bound; host replenishment is a premise.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.renewed_snapshot_keeps_quota : ∀ (ledger : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Ledger) (_snapshot renewed : NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.Snapshot), (∀ (checkpoint : ℕ), NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.chargedFor checkpoint ledger.charges ≤ renewed checkpoint) → NobleFoundation.AuthorityLedger.WithinQuota ledger renewed

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.realizable_of_uninhabited
theorems.claim: A universal realizability proposition is provable from a false precondition alone.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.realizable_of_uninhabited : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Relation), ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Admits r → NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.unrealizable_of_contradictory_post
theorems.claim: A contradictory postcondition under an inhabited domain refutes relational realizability.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.unrealizable_of_contradictory_post : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Relation), NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Admits r → (∀ (params : r.Params) (input : r.Input) (out : r.Output), r.pre params input → ¬r.post params input out) → ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.not_deterministic_of_two_outputs
theorems.claim: Two distinct satisfying outputs for one admissible input refute determinacy.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.not_deterministic_of_two_outputs : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Relation) {params : r.Params} {input : r.Input} {out₁ out₂ : r.Output}, r.pre params input → r.post params input out₁ → r.post params input out₂ → out₁ ≠ out₂ → ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Deterministic r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.deterministic_of_unique_output
theorems.claim: Per-input uniqueness entails determinacy; no output-search failure is claimed.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.deterministic_of_unique_output : ∀ (r : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Relation), (∀ (params : r.Params) (input : r.Input) (out₁ out₂ : r.Output), r.pre params input → r.post params input out₁ → r.post params input out₂ → out₁ = out₂) → NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Deterministic r

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment_inhabited
theorems.claim: The wrapping I64 increment relation has an inhabited domain.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment_inhabited : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Admits NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment_realizable
theorems.claim: The wrapping I64 increment has a typed output for every input.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment_realizable : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment_deterministic
theorems.claim: The wrapping I64 increment is deterministic.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment_deterministic : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Deterministic NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.increment

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.contradictory_inhabited
theorems.claim: The contradictory relation's domain is inhabited, so its refutation is not vacuous.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.contradictory_inhabited : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Admits NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.contradictory

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.contradictory_not_realizable
theorems.claim: The contradictory relation is not relationally realizable.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.contradictory_not_realizable : ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.contradictory

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool_two_outputs
theorems.claim: The underconstrained Bool relation has two distinct satisfying outputs for one input.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool_two_outputs : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool.post () 0 true ∧ NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool.post () 0 false ∧ true ≠ false

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool_realizable
theorems.claim: The underconstrained Bool relation is realizable.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool_realizable : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool_not_deterministic
theorems.claim: The underconstrained Bool relation is not deterministic.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool_not_deterministic : ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Deterministic NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.underconstrainedBool

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput_deterministic
theorems.claim: Determinacy of the empty-output relation holds vacuously.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput_deterministic : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Deterministic NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput_not_realizable
theorems.claim: The empty-output relation is not realizable despite its determinacy.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput_not_realizable : ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.determinacy_does_not_imply_realizability
theorems.claim: Determinacy alone never witnesses existence of a satisfying output.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.determinacy_does_not_imply_realizability : NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Deterministic NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput ∧ ¬NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.Realizable NobleFoundation.SpecQuality.emptyOutput

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.evalStep_hasDerivAt
theorems.claim: One node's evaluation is differentiable along the direction line whenever its operands are.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.evalStep_hasDerivAt : ∀ (values : ℝ → ℕ → ℝ) (tangents : ℕ → ℝ) (node : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Node) (is ip ds dp : ℕ → ℝ), (∀ slot ∈ node.operands, HasDerivAt (fun t => values t slot) (tangents slot) 0) → HasDerivAt (fun t => NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.evalStep (values t) node (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line is ds t) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line ip dp t)) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangentStep (values 0) tangents node ds dp) 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.valuesUpTo_hasDerivAt
theorems.claim: The denotation of every earlier node is differentiable along the direction line, by induction on the stored order.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.valuesUpTo_hasDerivAt : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.WellFormed graph → ∀ (is ip ds dp : ℕ → ℝ) (count index : ℕ), index < count → HasDerivAt (fun t => NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.valuesUpTo graph (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line is ds t) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line ip dp t) count index) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangentUpTo graph is ip ds dp count index) 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangent_is_directional_derivative
theorems.claim: The forward tangent is Mathlib's derivative of the intended-real denotation along the direction line at the declared assignment (the JVP specification).
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangent_is_directional_derivative : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.WellFormed graph → ∀ (is ip ds dp : ℕ → ℝ) (index : ℕ), HasDerivAt (fun t => NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.value graph (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line is ds t) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.line ip dp t) index) (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangent graph is ip ds dp index) 0

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.repeated_operand_contributes_twice
theorems.claim: A repeated operand contributes twice to its own adjoint, so accumulation adds rather than overwrites.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.repeated_operand_contributes_twice : ∀ (values : ℕ → ℝ) (consumerAdjoint : ℝ) (a : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.contribution values consumerAdjoint (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Node.mul a a) a = consumerAdjoint * (values a + values a)

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_step_adds_contribution
theorems.claim: One reverse step adds the processed consumer's contribution to an operand's adjoint.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_step_adds_contribution : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph) (values seed : ℕ → ℝ) (fuel operand : ℕ), NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed (fuel + 1) operand = NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed fuel operand + NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.contribution values (NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed fuel (graph.arity - 1 - fuel)) (graph.node (graph.arity - 1 - fuel)) operand

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_unchanged_when_operand_absent
theorems.claim: A node that is not an operand of the processed consumer leaves the adjoint unchanged, which is what makes descending order finalize an adjoint before its own step.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjoint_unchanged_when_operand_absent : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.Graph) (values seed : ℕ → ℝ) (fuel operand : ℕ), operand ∉ (graph.node (graph.arity - 1 - fuel)).operands → NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed (fuel + 1) operand = NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.adjointAfter graph values seed fuel operand

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_wellFormed
theorems.claim: The example graph's operands are strictly earlier, so it is a well-formed acyclic graph.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_wellFormed : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.WellFormed NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_value
theorems.claim: The example graph denotes 16 at the declared assignment: an input, an exact constant, an addition and a self-repeated multiplication.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_value : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.value NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph (fun x => 3) (fun x => 0) 3 = 16

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_tangent
theorems.claim: The example graph's forward tangent is 8 with unit direction on the used input slot and zero parameter directions.
theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_tangent : NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.tangent NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph (fun x => 3) (fun x => 0) (fun slot => if slot = 0 then 1 else 0) (fun x => 0) 3 = 8

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.ReverseAD.exampleGraph_derivative
theorems.claim: The example graph's tangent statement is exercised as Mathlib's derivative statement on a concrete graph.

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.foldl_eq_execSchedule

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.a_missing_second_operand_refuses_rather_than_fabricating

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.a_missing_second_operand_refuses_rather_than_fabricating : ∀ (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (regs : ℕ → Option NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val) (dst x y : ℕ), regs y = none → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step inputs regs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Instr.add dst x y) dst = none ∧ NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step inputs regs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Instr.sub dst x y) dst = none ∧ NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step inputs regs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Instr.mul dst x y) dst = none ∧ NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step inputs regs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Instr.eq dst x y) dst = none

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.an_unwritten_register_keeps_its_value

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step_computes : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.WellFormed graph → ∀ (schedule : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Schedule) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64) (regs : ℕ → Option NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val) (index : ℕ), (∀ operand ∈ (graph.node index).operands, regs (schedule.regOf operand) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs operand) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.step inputs regs (NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.emitNode graph schedule index) (schedule.regOf index) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index

theorems.name: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.execSchedule_sound

theorems.statement: NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.execSchedule_sound : ∀ (graph : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Graph), NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.WellFormed graph → ∀ (schedule : NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Schedule) (inputs : ℕ → BitVec 64), (∀ a ∈ schedule.order, ∀ b ∈ schedule.order, schedule.regOf a = schedule.regOf b → a = b) → ∀ (processed order : List ℕ) (regs : ℕ → Option NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.Val), (∀ index ∈ order ++ processed, index ∈ schedule.order) → (∀ index ∈ processed, index ∉ order) → NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.OrderOk graph processed order → order.Nodup → (∀ index ∈ processed, regs (schedule.regOf index) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index) → ∀ index ∈ order ++ processed, NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.execSchedule graph schedule inputs order regs (schedule.regOf index) = NobleFoundation.PackedSchedule.value graph inputs index
